question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"absolutely."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Absolutely"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
 
• It means "completely" or "totally." (पूरी तरह से; सर्वथा; संपूर्ण रूप से)
 
 
• **Example**: *It’s **absolutely**__ freezing outside!*
 
 
 
• It is an adverb of degree and is used to emphasize a statement.
 
• The sentence would mean that whatever action was being done, it was done completely or without any doubt.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct sentence: ......making __**absolutely**__ no sound as it melted.........

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "hardly",** means almost no; almost not; almost none. (लगभग कोई नहीं; लगभग कुछ नहीं; लगभग शून्‍य)
 
• **Option 2, "silently",** means without making any sound. (चुपचाप, ख़ामोशी से)
 
• **Option 3, "loudly",** means in a way that produces much noise. (एक तरह से जो बहुत शोर पैदा करता है)

45:Tb97,

The correct answer is **"disturbed."**
